baseline.name: Enumerate every histogram interval
baseline.approach: Extend every left endpoint rightward while tracking the minimum height.

why: The next smaller height determines a popped bar's maximal width, so already resolved candidates need no rescanning.
quantitative_comparison: The baseline examines n(n+1)/2 intervals. Each real bar enters and leaves the archived stack at most once, giving at most n pushes and n pops for those bars. These are different operation counts, not a speed multiplier.
tradeoffs: Linear auxiliary memory replaces the baseline's constant space. Allocation failure and int area overflow outside problem constraints are not handled.
evidence_basis: Monotonic-stack amortized analysis from the captured source and the defined interval baseline; no paired timing.
